supersedes.reason: The v1 distal-tail color threshold used uint8 additions that could wrap, and its prose described a selected-landmark maximum as the full-interval maximum.

audited_interval.basis: Previously audited apparent cycle: contact 60-64, load acceptance 65-71, midstance 72-87, terminal stance 88-97, toe-off 98-102, swing 103-113.

reference.method: Manual surface seeds propagated by consecutive normalized cross-correlation; distal tail from a deterministic fixed-background silhouette mask evaluated in signed int16 color arithmetic.
reference.limits: Pixels are fixed-camera qualitative timing evidence, not 3-D distance, anatomical joints, COM, force, or a calibrated motion target. Surface NCC and silhouette projection do not establish exact event alignment.

v9.limits: Serialized node-origin geometry only; it is not COM, load, force, or skin-mass evidence.

v10.limits: Serialized node-origin geometry only; it is not COM, load, force, or skin-mass evidence.

comparison_boundary: Reference and factory cameras, clocks, models, and geometry differ. Compare phase direction only; do not compare pixels to metres or infer Tarbosaurus mechanics.
